task:
Take the gender split from the 2011 Bulgarian census about those who have completed tertiary education. Subtract the smaller number from the larger number, then return the difference in thousands of women. So if there were 30.1 thousand more men, you'd give "30.1"

Provide a concise, precise answer. State your final answer on the last line, prefixed with "FINAL ANSWER: "

steps.content: Search for the official 2011 Bulgarian census data on educational attainment, specifically the number of men and women who have completed tertiary education. Extract the relevant numbers.

I typed '2011 POPULATION CENSUS Main Results tertiary education men women 2011 Bulgaria' into the search bar.  
The web browser is open to the page [2011 Bulgarian census educational attainment tertiary education numbers by gender - Search](https://www.bing.com/search?q=2011+Bulgarian+census+educational+attainment+tertiary+education+numbers+by+gender&form=QBLH&sp=-1&lq=0&pq=&sc=0-0&qs=n&sk=&cvid=0A81DC5DB135488789B8CEA69382C803).  
The viewport shows 54% of the webpage.  
The following text is visible in the viewport:  
- “[PDF] 2011 POPULATION CENSUS Main Results - nsi.bg”  
- “Women have completed tertiary education significantly more often than the men … 791.8 thousand women … and 586.9 thousand men … have tertiary education.”
Action: [{"type": "browser", "name": "input_text", "args": {"reasoning": "To initiate a search for the official 2011 Bulgarian census data on educational attainment and extract the number of men and women with tertiary education, I will enter a relevant query into the search box.", "input_field_id": 59, "text_value": "2011 Bulgarian census educational attainment tertiary education numbers by gender"}}]
Subtract 586.9 from 791.8 to get the difference in thousands of women who completed tertiary education according to the 2011 Bulgarian census. Output the answer as: 'FINAL ANSWER: [number]'

```python
women = 791.8
men = 586.9
difference = women - men
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {difference:.1f}")
```
Run the provided Python code to output the final answer.

According to the 2011 Bulgarian census, 791.8 thousand women and 586.9 thousand men had completed tertiary education. The difference between these numbers is 204.9 thousand, with more women than men.

FINAL ANSWER: 204.9
